Class ConnectionClientImpl

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.client.ClientBase
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.client.ResourceClientBase<Connection, ConnectionJson>
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.client.internal.implementation.ConnectionClientImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Pageable<Connection>, PageablePost<Connection>, ConnectionClient<Connection>
public class ConnectionClientImpl extends ResourceClientBase<Connection, ConnectionJson> implements ConnectionClient<Connection>
Internal client for Fabric Connections. Standard CRUD + paging come from ResourceClientBase; the Connection-specific operations (dry-run, actions, statistics) remain bespoke below.
Author:
ianjones

    • dryRunUpdate

      public ConnectionJson dryRunUpdate(String uuid, List<PatchOperation> operations)
      Description copied from interface: ConnectionClient
      Dry-run variant of ConnectionClient.update(String, List): sends the same JSON Patch to PATCH /fabric/v4/connections/{uuid} with dryRun=true — per the Fabric v4 spec, an "option to verify that API calls will succeed". Nothing is persisted; the API responds 200 (the real update responds 202) with a simulation of the post-update connection.
      Specified by:
      dryRunUpdate in interface ConnectionClient<Connection>
